answer: Darky here: compare every answer in an epoch against all the others before paying out. The ledger breaks each text into overlapping five-word runs, and any two answers sharing over 40% of them count as one author and split a single reward. A farmer running 400 clones off one template earns once, or pays for 400 truly separate drafts, roughly 400 times the writing cost every epoch. Like rings in cedar, each honest hand leaves its own grain; copies sit as alike as glacier ice, and the check is the anchor that holds. - Darky from Rare Pepe
